name: Artificial Intelligence
summary: This EA uses a neural network-inspired approach to predict price movement directions, employing a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) architecture trained on historical price data. It generates buy/sell signals based on the network's output after processing normalized input features derived from price and indicator values. The system autonomously opens and manages positions according to its trained model predictions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用受神经网络启发的方法来预测价格走势方向，采用在历史价格数据上训练的多层感知器(MLP)架构。它通过网络处理来自价格和指标值的归一化输入特征后生成买入/卖出信号，并根据训练好的模型预测自主开仓和管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于人工神经网络的多层感知器模型，通过输入层接收归一化的价格特征和指标数据，经过隐藏层的非线性变换后在输出层产生交易方向预测。入场条件为神经网络输出值超过预设阈值时触发买入或卖出信号，通常结合多个技术指标如移动平均线、RSI、MACD等作为输入特征。出场条件依赖止盈止损设置或反向信号生成，部分版本还包含追踪止损功能。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式，但通常缺乏高级资金管理策略如凯利公式或动态风险调整。资金管理方面，该EA的风险控制主要依赖静态止损和手数设定，缺乏自适应的仓位调整机制来应对市场波动率变化，整体风险敞口取决于网络预测的准确率和止损距离的设置。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) artificial neural network model that receives normalized price features and indicator data through the input layer, undergoes nonlinear transformations in hidden layers, and produces trading direction predictions at the output layer. Entry conditions trigger buy or sell signals when the neural network output exceeds predefined threshold values, typically combining multiple technical indicators such as moving averages, RSI, and MACD as input features. Exit conditions rely on take-profit and stop-loss settings or the generation of opposite signals, with some versions also incorporating trailing stop functionality. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or account balance-proportional lot calculations, but generally lacks advanced money management strategies such as the Kelly criterion or dynamic risk adjustment. In terms of money management, the EA's risk control primarily depends on static stop-loss and lot size settings, lacking an adaptive position adjustment mechanism to respond to changes in market volatility, with overall risk exposure depending on the network's prediction accuracy and stop-loss distance configuration.

pros: 利用机器学习方法自适应学习市场模式，理论上能捕捉非线性价格关系
多指标输入特征提供多维市场视角，增强信号可靠性
神经网络可定期重新训练以适应市场状态变化
自动化程度高，无需人工干预即可完成从分析到交易的完整流程
内置止损止盈机制提供基本风险保护
pros_en: Leverages machine learning methods to adaptively learn market patterns, theoretically capable of capturing nonlinear price relationships
Multi-indicator input features provide a multi-dimensional market perspective, enhancing signal reliability
Neural network can be periodically retrained to adapt to changing market conditions
Highly automated, completing the full process from analysis to trading without manual intervention
Built-in stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms provide basic risk protection
cons: 神经网络容易过拟合历史数据，在实盘中表现可能远逊于回测结果
缺乏高级资金管理策略，固定手数方式无法根据市场波动率动态调整风险敞口
训练数据量和质量对模型效果影响极大，数据不足时预测能力显著下降
黑盒特性使得策略逻辑难以解释和调试，出现亏损时难以定位问题根源
未包含滑点和点差的充分过滤，在高频交易环境下可能导致实际执行偏离预期
cons_en: Neural networks are prone to overfitting historical data, and live performance may fall far short of backtesting results
Lacks advanced money management strategies; fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Training data volume and quality significantly impact model effectiveness; insufficient data leads to notably degraded prediction ability
Black-box nature makes strategy logic difficult to explain and debug; hard to identify root causes when losses occur
Does not include adequate slippage and spread filtering, which may cause actual execution to deviate from expectations in high-frequency trading environments
improvements: 增加交叉验证和样本外测试机制以防止过拟合，引入正则化技术如Dropout或L2正则化
实现动态仓位管理，根据当前账户权益、市场波动率(ATR)和模型置信度自适应调整手数
加入市场状态识别模块，在不同市场环境（趋势/震荡/高波动）下切换不同的模型参数
增加滑点保护和点差过滤机制，在流动性不足或点差过大时禁止开仓
improvements_en: Add cross-validation and out-of-sample testing mechanisms to prevent overfitting; introduce regularization techniques such as Dropout or L2 regularization
Implement dynamic position sizing that adaptively adjusts lot size based on current account equity, market volatility (ATR), and model confidence
Add a market regime identification module to switch between different model parameters in different market environments (trending/ranging/high volatility)
Add slippage protection and spread filtering mechanisms to prohibit opening positions when liquidity is insufficient or spread is too wide

risk_points: 神经网络过拟合风险导致实盘表现不稳定，历史回测可能严重高估策略收益
缺乏动态止损调整机制，在剧烈波动行情中固定止损可能不足以保护账户
黑盒模型的不可解释性增加了策略失效时快速定位和修复的难度
未对交易时段和市场流动性进行过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生虚假信号
risk_points_en: Neural network overfitting risk leads to unstable live performance; historical backtesting may significantly overestimate strategy returns
Lack of dynamic stop-loss adjustment mechanism; fixed stop-loss may be insufficient to protect the account duringsevere volatile market conditions
Unexplainability of black-box models increases difficulty of quickly identifying and fixing issues when the strategy fails
No filtering for trading sessions and market liquidity; may generate false signals during low-liquidity periods
